parsed.title: AOL Guest Commenter
parsed.oneLiner: Allow users to post a single news comment by playing a mini-game instead of signing up.

newMechanic.name: Guest Posting
newMechanic.description: A temporary authorization to submit one comment to a news article discussion without a full AOL account registration. Guest comments are processed via AOL's automated safety filters to prevent spam [SAFE-1].
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The sign-up wall on the Add Comment Page (s05) prevents spontaneous interaction from guest users. Providing an ad-supported path monetizes high-intent non-signed-in users.

parsed.trigger: After entering text on the Add Comment Page when the sign-up modal appears.
parsed.eligibility: Non-signed-in users who have entered text in the comment box on the Add Comment Page.

offer.title: Post as a guest
offer.body: Don't want to sign up right now? Play a quick 15-second game to post this comment as a guest.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The guest pass is limited to a single comment per day and does not grant account benefits like comment history, replies, or profile customization. A sign-in contrast line reminds users that a full AOL account is required for permanent features [CANN-4].
risks: Potential for lower-quality comments from non-verified users
Increased moderation load if automated filters fail

evidence.quote: User attempts to post a comment on an article and hits the sign-up wall.

newElements.change: A SimulaRewardedAd interstitial invitation triggered by the sign-up modal on the Add Comment Page.

storyboard.caption: The user reads interesting comments on a news article.
When trying to comment, the user is blocked by a mandatory sign-up requirement.
A Simula interstitial offers a single guest post in exchange for a game.
The user plays an AOL-themed mini-game for 15 seconds.
The comment is published. A message suggests signing in to track comment history.
